mode.smarter_touhou_maids.agent.smarter_: Original Reflex Arc System Agent (Legacy BNN Chain)
option.smarter_touhou_maids.allow_posses:
Whether to allow the player to possess this maid
Press %s while aiming at a maid to toggle possession
Smarter AI activates only after possessing (vanilla AI is preserved otherwise)
debug.smarter_touhou_maids.vision.toolti:
Periodically dump vision to debug/smarter_touhou_maids/vision_debug (performance cost)
Config is stored per-maid (persists with world save data)
debug.smarter_touhou_maids.dt.tooltip:
Log urana tick interval dt (ms) each loop
Config is stored per-maid (persists with world save data)
debug.smarter_touhou_maids.effector.tool:
Log effector commands each tick
Config is stored per-maid (persists with world save data)
gui.smarter_touhou_maids.selector.title: Select Config GUI
gui.smarter_touhou_maids.selector.hint: Choose then click Open to enter
option.smarter_touhou_maids.persistence_:
When off, training results are not saved; each restart starts from scratch
Config is stored per-maid (persists with world save data)
Default state is auto-determined by whether the current path has persistable data
option.smarter_touhou_maids.periodic_sav:
When off, no periodic save during runtime, but a final save still occurs when smarter stops
Only effective when persistence is enabled
option.smarter_touhou_maids.save_interva:
Auto-save every N seconds (prevents data loss on crash)
Recommended around 30
Only effective when periodic save is enabled
option.smarter_touhou_maids.max_retentio:
How many historical versions to keep per maid
Oldest versions are auto-deleted when exceeded
Only effective when persistence is enabled
